extracted.intended_audience: general TED viewers; poets, spoken-word performers, and writers interested in adapting poems for performance/film
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing or selecting poems that work both as spoken-word/TED-style performances and as short animated-film adaptations, emphasizing tone, emotional impact, and humor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone — 'dry wit with artistic depth'
rubrics_metrics.description: Combining dry wit with artistic depth
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance humor and subtle irony (dry wit) with layers of feeling or insight (artistic depth) so poems are amusing without being trivial and resonant without losing levity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adaptability to animation/film — 'turned into delightful animated films'
rubrics_metrics.description: Several of his poems were turned into delightful animated films
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poems should contain vivid imagery, clear narrative moments, or concrete scenes that can be translated visually; collaborate with filmmakers to preserve tone while exploiting animation's strengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entertainment value — 'wonderfully entertaining'
rubrics_metrics.description: Five of them are included in this wonderfully entertaining ... talk
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select or craft pieces that engage and sustain audience attention in a live/talk setting; pacing, variety, and accessible hooks help maintain entertainment value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional impact — 'moving'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for poems that evoke genuine feeling or insight; emotional resonance should coexist with wit and not be sacrificed for jokes or spectacle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Humor and strong closer — 'don't miss the hilarious final poem!'
rubrics_metrics.description: don't miss the hilarious final poem!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include well-placed humor and consider sequencing so a memorable, high-impact (e.g., hilarious) closing piece leaves the audience satisfied; a strong finale can elevate the whole set.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability for spoken delivery / transcript readability — 'Read transcript'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poems should work both when read on the page and performed aloud; clarity of language, rhythmic flow, and performative cues improve spoken delivery while remaining readable in transcript form.
